programs.name: Computing (QD, Bachelor of Computing (Honours), Faculty of Arts and Science)
programs.a_level_offer: Three GCE Advanced Levels (General Paper excluded) plus two GCSE/IGCSE subjects; Mathematics at A-Level and two other A-Levels required; English at GCSE/IGCSE. Competitive A-Level grades are B or higher and GCSE/IGCSE C or 4 or higher. Queen's publishes no program-specific A-Level offer.
programs.ib_offer: Full IB Diploma (six subjects, three at HL, no mark below 3) with at least 28 points excluding bonus points, plus a score competitive for the program; English and Mathematics required (Math Applications and Interpretations SL not accepted). Queen's publishes no program-specific IB points.
programs.ap_offer: AP / US High School Diploma: Grade 12 graduation with a minimum admission GPA of B- based on four senior-level academic courses from an accredited high school. Required courses: Grade 12 English (two terms) and four full-year courses in Mathematics; calculus recommended. Queen's is test-optional (SAT/ACT may be submitted, not required). No AP exam scores are required.
programs.required_subjects: IB: English and Mathematics. A-Level: Mathematics at A-Level plus two other A-Levels, English at GCSE/IGCSE. US/AP: Grade 12 English (two terms) and four full-year courses in Mathematics (calculus recommended).
programs.toefl_note: Old 0-120 scale (tests before January 2026): 88 overall, minimum 20 in each of Writing, Speaking, Reading and Listening. New 1-6 scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026): 4.5 overall with no skill lower than 4.0.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 with no band below 6.0; Duolingo 120; PTE Academic 60; Cambridge English 175 with no component below 170. No test needed with a completed IB Diploma, three years in a country where English is the primary language, or three years of full-time English-medium study.
programs.notes: Last year's competitive high school average for Computing (QD): high-70s percent (Queen's says minimums vary and may be higher). Queen's takes international applications through OUAC, Common App or the Queen's International Application portal (https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/how-to-apply). Deadline: March 1, 2027 for all first-year full-time programs except Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing; all documents including transcripts and English scores by March 31, 2027 (https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/dates-deadlines). Fee: 2026-27 international 'Computing - Years 1-6' tuition for 30 units, CAD 54,808.20 (per unit CAD 1,826.94), rounded; Fall 2027 rates were not published; ancillary fees and UHIP are extra (https://www.queensu.ca/registrar/tuition-fees/undergraduate). A-Level route: https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/admission-requirements/british-pattern-education-advanced-levels . AP route: https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/admission-requirements/advanced-placement and https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/admission-requirements/united-states . Competitive average: https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/competitive-average . English: https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applicants/english-proficiency . The course length is not stated on these pages, so it is not shown.

programs.name: Smith Engineering, general (common) first year (QE)
programs.a_level_offer: Three GCE Advanced Levels (General Paper excluded) plus two GCSE/IGCSE subjects; Mathematics and either Chemistry or Physics must be at A-Level; English, Mathematics, Chemistry and Physics required. Competitive A-Level grades are B or higher and GCSE/IGCSE C or 4 or higher. Queen's publishes no program-specific A-Level offer.
programs.ib_offer: Full IB Diploma (six subjects, three at HL, no mark below 3) with at least 28 points excluding bonus points, plus a score competitive for the program; Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics and English required (Math Applications and Interpretations SL not accepted). The engineering admission average uses only the prerequisite subjects. Queen's publishes no program-specific IB points.
programs.ap_offer: AP / US High School Diploma: Grade 12 graduation with a minimum admission GPA of B- based on four senior-level academic courses from an accredited high school. Required courses: Grade 12 English (two terms); four full-year courses in Mathematics and Science; one (preferably two) full-year courses in each of Chemistry and Physics. Queen's is test-optional (SAT/ACT may be submitted, not required). No AP exam scores are required.
programs.required_subjects: IB: Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics and English. A-Level route: English, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics (Mathematics and Chemistry or Physics at A-Level). US/AP: Grade 12 English (two terms), four full-year Mathematics and Science courses, one (preferably two) full-year each of Chemistry and Physics.
programs.toefl_note: Old 0-120 scale (tests before January 2026): 88 overall, minimum 20 in each of Writing, Speaking, Reading and Listening. New 1-6 scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026): 4.5 overall with no skill lower than 4.0.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 with no band below 6.0; Duolingo 120; PTE Academic 60; Cambridge English 175 with no component below 170. No test needed with a completed IB Diploma, three years in a country where English is the primary language, or three years of full-time English-medium study.
programs.notes: This is the general first-year engineering route (QE): everyone takes the same first year and chooses a discipline after it (Queen's states a guaranteed choice among 10 disciplines); Mechanical Engineering is also open as Direct Entry (QET) with the same prerequisites and a low-90s competitive average (https://www.queensu.ca/admission/study-engineering). Last year's competitive high school average for Engineering (QE): low-90s percent (Queen's says minimums vary and may be higher). Queen's takes international applications through OUAC, Common App or the Queen's International Application portal (https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/how-to-apply). Deadline: March 1, 2027 for all first-year full-time programs except Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing; all documents by March 31, 2027 (https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/dates-deadlines). Fee: 2026-27 international 'Engineering & Applied Science - Years 1-5' tuition for 32.2 units, CAD 59,283.74 (per unit CAD 1,841.11), rounded; Fall 2027 rates were not published; ancillary fees and UHIP are extra (https://www.queensu.ca/registrar/tuition-fees/undergraduate). Degree name from https://smithengineering.queensu.ca/student-experience/incoming/about-your-degree.html (students have four to six years to complete). A-Level route: https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/admission-requirements/british-pattern-education-advanced-levels . AP route: https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/admission-requirements/advanced-placement and https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/admission-requirements/united-states . Competitive average: https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applying/competitive-average . English: https://www.queensu.ca/admission/applicants/english-proficiency . The course length is not shown.
